synopses.An Echo of Things to Come: Licanius, Boo: After a devastating attack, the Augurs are given an amnesty. Davian and his allies head north to the weakening Boundary, while Caeden races to keep his bargain with the Lyth as his memories return.
synopses.The Light of All That Falls: Licanius, B: The Boundary is whole again, but Banes roam Andarra and the Venerate gather their armies. Wirr holds the alliance together in Ilin Illan while Davian is a prisoner in a strange land.
synopses.Royal Assassin: The Farseer Trilogy, Boo: Fitz comes back to court after barely surviving his first mission. King Shrewd is near death, Fitz's only ally is away on a quest, and Red Ship Raiders are slaughtering coastal towns.
synopses.Assassin's Quest: The Farseer Trilogy, B: King Shrewd is dead and Fitz is believed dead. Fitz comes back scarred and sets out to kill Regal, while the rightful heir, Verity, is lost on his quest.
synopses.The Farseer: Assassin's Apprentice: Fitz, the bastard son of a prince, is raised in the royal stables and secretly trained as the king's assassin.
synopses.Treason Keep: Demon Child, Book 2: R'shiel is near death after the rebellion against her mother, and only the Harshini can heal her. On the northern border, Tarja and the Defenders are too few to hold off Karien.
synopses.Medalon: Demon Child, Book 1: Medalon is ruled by the Sisters of the Blade and their army of Defenders, and the magical Harshini are believed extinct. The story follows R'shiel, daughter of the First Sister, and her half-brother Tarja.
synopses.Harshini: Demon Child, Book 3: Medalon has surrendered to Karien. Damin Wolfblade must end the siege of the Hythrun capital before he can help, and R'shiel has accepted that she is the Demon Child.
synopses.City of Gods and Monsters: House of Devi: Loren Calla is a human in Angelthene, a city run by vampires, werewolves and witches. She narrowly escapes being taken by Darkslayers, supernatural bounty hunters, and has to find out why they want her.
synopses.City of Souls and Sinners: House of Devi: Loren and Darien are back in their old routines when the Terran Imperator blackmails Loren into working for him and expects her to use magic she no longer seems to have.
synopses.City of Lies and Legends: House of Devil: Loren has fallen into a coma, and Darien leaves Angelthene to chase a secret that might bring her back. In Yveswich, Roman Devlin of the House of Black crosses paths with Shay Cousens.
synopses.Of Blood and Fire: The Bound and the Bro: In a village in southern Epheria, Calen Bryer is preparing for The Proving, a test of courage. Three strangers arrive and pull him into a war that began centuries ago.
synopses.Of Darkness and Light: The Bound and the: Calen and his companions defend Belduar and its new king as the Lorian empire comes to its walls. His sister Ella reaches the port of Antiquar, and Rist trains his new powers with the Circle of Magii.
synopses.Scythe: Humanity has beaten death. Scythes are the only ones who can end a life, and they must, to keep the population down. Two teenagers, Citra and Rowan, are chosen as apprentices.
synopses.The Toll: Citra and Rowan have disappeared, and nothing seems to stand between Scythe Goddard and power over the whole scythedom.
synopses.Thunderhead: Arc of a Scythe: A year after Rowan went off grid, he hunts corrupt scythes, while Citra, now Scythe Anastasia, gleans with compassion and challenges the new order.
synopses.Mage Tank 2: A LitRPG Adventure: Arlo's party, Fortune's Folly, has beaten the specter of Orexis, and the System has given them a Get Out of Cage Free Card.
synopses.Mage Tank 3: A LitRPG Adventure: Fortune's Folly reaches level 10 and enters Deijin's Descent, a legendary Delve where time runs out fast.
synopses.Mage Tank: A LitRPG Adventure: Arlo dies and wakes in a world where people earn power by clearing ancient dungeons called Delves. Nobody explains the rules.
synopses.King of Scars: King of Scars Duology, Bo: Nikolai Lantsov, the young king of Ravka, tries to rebuild his country after a civil war while hiding a dark magic that is growing inside him.
synopses.Rule of Wolves: King of Scars Duology, B: Fjerda's army is ready to invade Ravka. Nikolai prepares to fight, Zoya has to become the weapon her country needs, and Nina works undercover in Fjerda.
synopses.The Wise Man's Fear: Kingkiller Chronicl: Day two of Kvothe's telling: he takes his first steps on the path of the hero.
synopses.The Name of the Wind: Kingkiller Chronic: Kvothe, now an innkeeper living under another name, tells a chronicler the story of his life, starting with his childhood among travelling players.
synopses.The Fiery Cross: In 1771, Jamie Fraser and Claire, his wife from the twentieth century, live in the colony of North Carolina. Claire knows a revolution is coming and warns him.
synopses.Outlander: Outlander, Book 1: In 1945 Claire Randall, a former combat nurse, walks through a circle of standing stones in Scotland and finds herself in 1743.
synopses.The Lies of Locke Lamora: Gentleman Bast: Locke Lamora is an orphan in the island city of Camorr, raised by a priest who trains thieves. He grows up to lead the Gentleman Bastards, who con the city's nobles.
synopses.Red Seas Under Red Skies: Gentleman Bast: After a brutal fight with Camorr's underworld, Locke and Jean have fled to Tal Verrar. Their new target is the Sinspire, the most heavily guarded gambling house in the world.
synopses.Hyperion: Seven pilgrims travel to the Time Tombs on the planet Hyperion, where a creature called the Shrike waits. On the way, each tells their story.
synopses.The Fall of Hyperion: The Time Tombs on Hyperion are opening.
synopses.Among the Burning Flowers: A Novel: A short prequel to The Priory of the Orange Tree, set in Yscalin as the sleeping dragons begin to wake.
synopses.The Things Gods Break: The Crucible, Boo: Book 2 of The Crucible. It picks up after The Games Gods Play.
synopses.The Astral Library: A Novel: Alix Watson grew up in foster care and works three jobs. She spends her nights reading at the Boston Public Library, until she goes through a hidden door into a library where people escape into their favourite books.
synopses.Shield of Sparrows: Princess Odessa was never meant to rule or fight. Then she is the daughter given in marriage to seal an old treaty, and has to cross monster-filled lands beside a warrior who despises her.
synopses.A Song to Drown Rivers: A Novel: Based on the legend of Xishi, one of the Four Beauties of ancient China. Fanli, a young military advisor, notices her in her village and trains her as a spy to send into the enemy king's court.
synopses.Isles of the Emberdark: A Cosmere Novel: Sixth of the Dusk is a trapper of Aviar, the birds his people bond with, on the island of Patji. Invaders from the stars want the Aviar, and his people are racing to modernize before they are conquered.
synopses.The Will of the Many: Hierarchy, Book 1: Vis Telimus says he is an orphan who got into the Catenan Republic's best academy by luck. He is lying about who he is and about why he is there.
synopses.The Sword of Kaigen: A Theonite War Stor: The Matsuda family of the Kusanagi Peninsula are warriors who can raise the sea and make blades of ice. Fourteen-year-old Mamoru trains to defend the Empire. His mother, Misaki, put away her sword when she married.
synopses.Shadows upon Time: Sun Eater, Book 7: The seventh and last Sun Eater novel.
synopses.Quicksilver: The Fae & Alchemy Series, B: Saeris Fane is a thief in a desert city where water is rationed. She opens a gateway by accident and lands in Yvelia, a frozen Fae realm at war, bound to a Fae warrior called Kingfisher.
synopses.Sunrise on the Reaping (The Hunger Games: Twenty-four years before The Hunger Games. Haymitch Abernathy of District 12 is reaped for the fiftieth Games.
synopses.Alchemised: Helena Marino was an alchemist on the losing side of a war. Now a prisoner with gaps in her memory, she is handed to a necromancer whose job is to find out what she has forgotten.
synopses.The Games Gods Play: Lyra is a clerk for the Order of Thieves in San Francisco, cursed by Zeus. Every hundred years the gods hold a contest called the Crucible, and this time Hades picks her as his champion.
synopses.The Serpent and the Wings of Night: Crow: Oraya is the human adopted daughter of the Nightborn vampire king. She enters the Kejari, a tournament held by the goddess of death, where she needs an ally to survive.
synopses.The Devils: Brother Diaz is called to the Sacred City expecting a reward. Instead he is put in charge of a congregation of murderers, sorcerers and monsters and sent on a mission for the Church.
synopses.A Parade of Horribles: Dungeon Crawler C: Book 8 of Dungeon Crawler Carl. On the tenth floor, Carl and Donut have to compete in a series of races.
synopses.Voyage of the Damned: The twelve heirs of Concordia's provinces sail together on the emperor's ship. Each has a secret magical Blessing except Ganymedes. When one heir is murdered, he has to find the killer.
synopses.A Requiem for Fallen Stars: Cadence of t: Lyra Izacalli makes a blood wager with a king for her freedom, then enters the deadly entrance exams of an academy built for the nobility.
synopses.Blood of Hercules: Villains of Lore, Boo: Alexis is a foster child in a world ruled by Spartans, immortals from twelve royal families. A blood test shows she is one of them, and she is sent to the Spartan War Academy.
synopses.Bonds of Hercules: Book 2 of Villains of Lore. It picks up after Blood of Hercules.
synopses.Spark the Flames: A Romantasy: Secret of: A woman has been in hiding since her family was slaughtered. Aeson Noctis, the king's second son, finds her and takes her to Paragon City, the dragons' capital. She goes looking for answers.
synopses.The God Is Not Willing: A Novel of the M: Set years after the main Malazan series. The Malazan army marches north, where the tribes beyond the border are growing uneasy.
synopses.The Wolf and the Crown of Blood: In Vartena, every monarch is sacrificed and brought back to life to keep peace with the gods. When rebellion stirs, the god-king sends his assassin, the Wolf, after Princess Bryony.
synopses.We Will Be Jaguars: A Memoir of My Peopl: A memoir by Nemonte Nenquimo of the Waorani people of Ecuador's Amazon: her childhood in the rainforest and her fight to protect it.
synopses.When Swords Fall Silent: An Epic Fantasy: Short stories about assassins and hired blades, by more than a dozen fantasy and science fiction authors.
synopses.When the Tides Held the Moon: New York, early 1900s. A young Puerto Rican immigrant helps capture a merman for a Coney Island sideshow, then gets to know him.
synopses.Between Two Rivers: Ancient Mesopotamia: A history of ancient Mesopotamia, the land between the Tigris and Euphrates where writing began, told through what its people wrote down and left behind.
synopses.The Primal Hunter: A LitRPG Adventure: Jake is an office worker and hobby archer. When Earth is absorbed into a multiverse run by a System, he is dropped into a tutorial full of monsters.
synopses.Vicious: Villains, Book 1: Victor and Eli were college roommates who worked out how a person could gain extraordinary abilities. Ten years later Victor breaks out of prison to find Eli.
synopses.Vengeful: Villains, Book 2: Book 2 of Villains. Marcella Riggins survives a brush with death with a new power and sets out to take the city of Merit.
synopses.Warm Up: A short prequel to Vicious. David survived an avalanche and came back with a power he is afraid of. He has not left his house in 297 days.
synopses.Heir: Set in the world of An Ember in the Ashes, years later. An orphan, a tracker in exile and a crown prince are pulled together by a killer loose in the Martial Empire.
synopses.Empire: Book 2 of the Heir duology, and the last.
synopses.The Emperor's Enemy: Unsurvivable Love D: Zora Ravenal joined the Crimson Army to destroy the Empire and became a Knight Mage. Now she is forced into close quarters with a Royal Mage from the other side.
synopses.The Sun and the Starmaker: The village of Reverie gets its light from the Starmaker, who pulls sunlight over the mountains every morning. On her wedding day Aurora Finch meets him, and he takes her to his castle to train her magic.
synopses.Jade War: The Green Bone Saga, Book 2: Book 2 of the Green Bone Saga. The clans' fight over jade spreads beyond the island of Kekon.
synopses.Jade Legacy: The Green Bone Saga, Book 3: Book 3 of the Green Bone Saga, and the last.
synopses.Skyward: Spensa wants to be a pilot like her father, who was branded a coward. Her people live on a planet that has been under attack from an alien fleet for decades.
synopses.Sunreach: Skyward Flight, Novella 1: A Skyward Flight novella told by FM, set between Starsight and Cytonic.
synopses.ReDawn: Skyward Flight, Novella 2: A Skyward Flight novella told by Alanik, set between Starsight and Cytonic.
synopses.Evershore: Skyward Flight, Novella 3: A Skyward Flight novella told by Jorgen, set alongside Cytonic.
synopses.Blightfall: Riftwake, Book 1: The first Riftwake book, set after the Skyward series. Arturo Mendez leads Skyward Flight on a search for lost human settlements.
synopses.The Shadows Between Us: Alessandra has a plan: court the Shadow King, marry him, then kill him and take his kingdom.
synopses.When the Moon Hatched: Moonfall, Book 1: In this world dead dragons curl up in the sky as moons, and moons can fall. Raeve, an assassin for a rebel group, is caught and imprisoned by the Guild of Nobles. Kaan Vaegor, a king mourning a lost love, crosses her path.
synopses.The Bone Shard War: The Drowning Empire,: Book 3 of The Drowning Empire, and the last.
synopses.Part of Your World: Alexis Montgomery, an ER doctor from a wealthy family, meets Daniel Grant, a small-town carpenter ten years younger than her.
synopses.Just for the Summer: Justin and Emma have the same problem: everyone they date finds a soulmate right after the breakup. They decide to date each other to cancel it out.
synopses.The Tainted Cup: Shadow of the Leviathan: An imperial officer is found dead with a tree grown out of his body. Ana Dolabra, an investigator, and her new assistant Dinios Kol are given the case.
synopses.A Drop of Corruption: Shadow of the Levi: A Treasury officer vanishes from a locked room in a guarded tower in Yarrowdale. Ana Dolabra and Dinios Kol are sent to investigate.
synopses.A Trade of Blood: Shadow of the Leviatha: The heir of a powerful family sits in jail for murder, covered in the victim's blood and unable to explain it. Ana Dolabra has to clear him, or the canton of Sapirdad goes to war.
synopses.Iron Flame: Empyrean, Book 2: Book 2 of the Empyrean. Violet starts her second year at Basgiath War College.
synopses.The Shadow of the Gods: The Bloodsworn S: A century after the gods destroyed each other, their bones still hold power. In the land of Vigrid the story follows three people: a huntress, a noblewoman looking for battle fame, and a thrall who wants vengeance.
synopses.Starside: Starside, Book 1: Every fifty years, fifty mortals may cross into Starside, the realm of the immortals, to reach a pool of magic. Aris goes to kill the goddess who burned her village.
synopses.Dark Matter: Jason Dessen, a college physics professor, is kidnapped and wakes up in a life where he never married and is a famous scientist. He tries to get back to his family.
synopses.Kingdom of Ash: Book 7 of Throne of Glass, and the last.
synopses.The Claude Cowork Handbook: A guide to using Claude Cowork, written for people who are not programmers.
synopses.30-Day Executive Functioning Skills Mast: A 30-day program of exercises for adults with ADHD to build planning, focus and organisation.
synopses.Jazz: Harlem, winter 1926. Joe Trace, a middle-aged salesman, shoots his teenage lover. At her funeral his wife, Violet, attacks the body. The novel goes back over how they got there.
synopses.The Coldest Girl in Coldtown: Vampires and the people they infect are quarantined in walled cities called Coldtowns. Tana wakes after a party to find almost everyone dead, and heads for a Coldtown with her infected ex-boyfriend and a strange boy.
synopses.The Queen of Nothing: The Folk of the Ai: Book 3 of The Folk of the Air, and the last.
synopses.A Deal with the Shadow King: Curse of th: A princess is sold by her father to the Shadow King and taken to live at his court in Faerie.
